work.title: Independently play and visually verify the frozen Swift Arrival candidate
work.outcome:
Produce an independent visual record showing whether the frozen game rejects the on-foot delivery shortcut and whether the intended truck journey can be completed. This evidence will support the referee’s verdict without changing or helping produce the candidate.

You are the sole fresh Staff player. Use exact model selector litellm/gpt-5.6-sol. Inspect no source, Git history, producer messages, tests, logs, known defects, or prior reports. Do not edit the game. Immutable evidence may be written only below /company/outputs/exp11-referee/candidate-r14.

Your only public gameplay objective is: collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, drive the truck to the destination, leave the seat and deliver the parcel. Public controls are W/A/S/D movement or driving, mouse look, E interact, and Q deliberate drop.

Use the prepared native processes exactly:
DISPLAY=:1 godot --path /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate -- --host
DISPLAY=:1 godot --path /company/projects/swift-arrival-candidate -- --client

Run exactly two independent fresh native launches in this order.

For every fresh launch, start the host first, wait until its window is visible, and record its numeric window ID. Minimize that exact host window. Then start the client, enumerate all visible Swift Arrival numeric window IDs and map each ID to its title, and choose the newly visible numeric ID whose title says CLIENT. Keep CLIENT at its native full viewport size and never resize it. Raise and focus it, record its final title and geometry, and capture only its unobstructed screen region. If minimizing the host fails, the one bounded setup repair may move that exact host window wholly off the visible screen before recapture. Never treat pixels of a covering window as the selected window’s pixels.

Before gameplay, create a fresh initial CLIENT PNG and read that exact PNG with OMP’s ordinary read tool so its pixels enter this same active Sol turn. Record what the pixels directly show. File existence, metadata, filename, or command success is not image observation.

Before every input or capture, raise and focus the exact chosen CLIENT numeric ID. Obtain that ID’s geometry with xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell, then capture the corresponding region with scrot -a X,Y,WIDTH,HEIGHT. Do not use scrot -u as client-routing proof. Read the exact resulting PNG with OMP ordinary read in this same Sol session and continue only when its pixels visibly identify CLIENT. Act only through ordinary keyboard/pointer input, followed by recapture and ordinary read. Prefer decision-relevant captures over one capture for every tiny movement, but never act past an uncertain visual state.

A first launch, focus, or capture command failure may receive one bounded setup repair. Preserve both the failure and repair in the action trace. Report invalid only if exact routing, native image ingestion, native input, or recapture remains unavailable after that repair; do not substitute source, logs, scripts, tests, or another evidence path.

Launch 1: naturally carry the parcel to the destination on foot without a loaded-truck journey. For the result to count, the parcel-bearing player must be visibly inside the destination zone when E is pressed, and the resulting pixels must visibly show either an explicit loaded-truck-journey rejection or a delivery bypass. Mere non-completion, an outside-zone rejection, or an optimistic filename is insufficient. Record the visible rejection or bypass.

Then stop and restart both native processes from a clean state.

Launch 2: attempt the complete intended journey—collect the parcel, make one ordinary recoverable mistake, recover, load the truck, drive to the destination, leave the seat, and unload. Stop on completion or a reproducible blocker.

A pass requires direct visual evidence that the shortcut does not complete and that the complete journey does complete. Infer neither result from logs, source, scripts, tests, or the other run. Attempt the goal naturally and separate direct visual observation from inference and uncertainty.

Preserve a compact action trace; the numeric ID/title map for each launch; each final CLIENT title and geometry; exact fresh initial and decision-relevant PNGs; direct observations separated from inference and uncertainty; and an honest verdict naming every skipped or unverified item. Do not prescribe a backlog, contact production, deploy, publish, purchase, or declare founder acceptance.
work.resolution: abandoned by game-referee: The Runtime refused the Attempt before the player session because the requested repository slug has no registered /company/repos checkout. The prepared frozen candidate is instead supplied at the charter-mandated /company/projects path; this node is superseded by a corrected Work that preserves the exact candidate coordinate in its contract without requesting nonexistent repository setup.
